slides.texte_overlay:
Rules for being the guest
everyone invites back

1. Never arrive empty-handed

Dessert, flowers, a good bottle
of something. Anything.

2. Arrive on time,
not early

Ten minutes early catches
the host still getting ready.

3. Bring good conversation

A story, a question, something
you learned this week.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Bring good conversation

A story, a question, something
you learned this week
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Offer to help
in the kitchen

Then actually help.
Dishes count.

5. Phone stays
in your pocket

You were invited for you,
not your screen.

6. Leave before
they get tired

The best guests leave
the night wanting more.

7. Text thanks
the next morning

One line. Name one thing
you loved.
